newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares close at new peak, outlook positive.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares close at new peak, outlook positive.

text.p: The Danish bourse's top-20 KFX index closed at an all-time high for the second day running on Wednesday, with dealers seeing the positive market mood continuing on Thursday with the prospect of further new records.
"If the dollar holds at its new stronger level and bonds are unaffected by FOC, I can see nothing to prevent the market from continuing its upward surge," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index ended the day 0.95 point higher at a new record closing high of 175.58 in overall bourse turnover of 1.455 billion crowns. The KFX August future rose 1.70 point to 176.40 with 47 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Dealers said they did not see any short-term sign of any correction on top of the recent days' advances.

Tele Danmark TLD,N was the only KFX paper to fall, hit by negative market reaction to its 2.2 billion crown acquisition of German mobile telephone company Talkline for what dealers felt was too high a price. The Tele Danmark share slipped two crowns to close at 345.
Danisco and Den Danske Bank continued their recent progress putting on three and 10 crowns to finish at 417 and 680 crowns respectively.
